title: Poco F9 Pro and F9 Ultra announced

The F9 Pro gets the recently announced Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V Series (SM8850-1-AB). According to Qualcomm’s own documents, the V series version of the chip features a slightly watered-down GPU. title: Tecno will bring a bezelless concept phone to IFA, a laptop with a 360° hinge and more
description: Cheap phones have big bezels around their screens. Premium phones have thinner bezels. And Tecno’s concept phone has no bezels – literally 0mm. Welcome to IFA 2026. title: Samsung unveils $800 Galaxy Book6 with 14" display and Intel Core 3/5 processors
description: Samsung is adding a new member to the Galaxy Book6 family of laptops today – a new 14” Galaxy Book6. It is a Windows 11 machine (also available with Linux) that starts at $800 / £800 / €850. The laptop has a 14” 16:10 LCD with an anti-glare coating (1,920 x 1,200px resolution, 350 nits brightness). This model measures 15.7mm thick and weighs 1.35kg (2.98lbs). The Samsung Galaxy Book6 has a 14” 16:10 display with an anti-glare coating The laptop has a 61.2Wh battery and promises to last up to 25 hours on a single charge. title: Tim Cook steps down as CEO of Apple, John Ternus takes over
description: Today marks a major turning point for Apple – Tim Cook steps down as CEO and John Ternus takes the reins. Cook has been with Apple since 1998 and became CEO in 2011 after Steve Jobs resigned due to health reasons. The iPhone 5, 5s and 5c were the last models designed with oversight by Jobs. Jobs passed just days after the iPhone 4s was unveiled, but he still influenced the design of the 5-series during its development. Everything after that has been under the guiding hand of Cook. title: Lava makes its UK debut with the launch of Agni 4N
description: Indian handset maker Lava has entered the UK smartphone market with the launch of Agni 4N (Agni means fire). Lava says the Agni 4N is "designed to deliver a premium smartphone experience at an accessible price point" and "combines flagship-grade performance, thoughtful design, and user-centric innovation for UK consumers." The Lava Agni 4N flaunts a metal build and packs a 6.67" AMOLED display with Gorilla Glass 5 protection.
